value.rationale: The line graph of the Petersen graph is a canonical symmetric four-regular 15-vertex graph, rather than an arbitrary subfamily. The adjacent natural four- and five-cut stages exhibit distinct top-dimensional graph-cycle constraints and yield two complete integral sphere-wedge classifications of the Alexander duals. The result supplies dual simple homotopy information and all integral cut-side homology, not merely numerical Betti approximations; finite scope and computational nature are explicit.
